svg.title: Two ways a job loses time to NUMA domains
svg.desc: Each picture shows one Genoa socket with 4 NUMA domains. First, a job with all its cores in one NUMA domain fetches its data from close by, but the same job spread over three NUMA domains has to fetch some of its data from another domain, which is slower. Second, a thread stores its data in domain 0, then the operating system moves the thread to domain 1, and from then on every fetch of that data comes from another domain.
